verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway centralizes provider credentials and keeps them away from clients: they are managed at the gateway, can be referenced from external secret backends through AI Vault, and clients are shielded from provider specifics. AI Auth Strategy adds a separate inbound authentication layer, including OIDC/IdP, that can be attached to models, agents and MCP servers. However, the evidence never explicitly describes minting or issuing gateway-managed API keys per team or app. missing for 10: explicit documentation of creating or issuing per-team/per-app gateway keys, key lifecycle (rotation/revocation) for those keys, independent or hands-on corroboration.
